title: Second power mean and second norm
statement: For every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, its power mean of order two under the uniform measure equals its $L^2$ norm: $(\mathbb E|f|^2)^{1/2}=\sqrt{\mathbb E[f^2]}$.
replaced: For every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, the power mean $(\E|f|^2)^{1/2}$ equals the second norm $\sqrt{\E[f^2]}$.
